mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical fourteen-period Choppiness Index crossing below 38.2 on completed four-hour BTC auctions marks release from range-like price action; follow the sign of the completed fourteen-bar displacement for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when the release bar close is strictly above the close fourteen completed bars earlier; short when strictly below
mechanism.why_distinct: Breakout candidates trade price crossing a range boundary, ADX trades directional-movement strength, and Aroon trades extrema recency. HVCIR uses the logarithmic ratio of summed true range to the completed-window high-low span as a regime-release event, with direction supplied only by fixed-horizon displacement; it uses no boundary crossing, OI, flow, volume, funding, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse four-hour path-efficiency regime releases are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.true_range: max(high-low, abs(high-prior completed close), abs(low-prior completed close))
features.choppiness_index: 100*log10(sum latest 14 true ranges/(latest 14 highest high-lowest low))/log10(14), finite with strict positive range
features.release: current completed-bar Choppiness Index <38.2 and immediately prior completed-bar value >=38.2
features.direction: sign(current completed close minus completed close fourteen bars earlier), strict nonzero
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical path-efficiency release under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no Choppiness period, threshold, direction, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: canonical Choppiness Index convention attributed to E. W. Dreiss
external_basis.fixed_definition: 14 completed periods; 100*log10(sum(TR,14)/(highest high-lowest low,14))/log10(14); release on strict crossing below 38.2
external_basis.selection_use: standard published period, lower Fibonacci threshold, and trend-following interpretation only; no incidence or outcomes
